# H2 self-contained staged TODOs

The stream is deliberately split into finite mathematics, same-measure
physical calibration, nonlinear Yang--Mills input, and continuum handoff.
Completing a later phase never retroactively closes an earlier open gate.

## Phase 0 -- scope and guardrails

- [x] Freeze H2 as a physical-length exponent on a centered observable
  cocycle, not a contraction rate per descriptive level.
- [x] Separate positive bad-subkernel transport, centered observable
  transport, and the reconstructed temporal semigroup.
- [x] Record cutoff, volume, history, distance, observable, and gauge-group
  quantifiers.
- [x] Cap current results at C2 with a C3 conditional OS handoff.

- [x] State the changing-state-space weighted cocycle theorem.
- [x] Retain the initial root moment rather than hiding it in a prefactor.
- [x] Add multiplicative step defects and derive their cumulative budget.
- [x] Prove the positive-rate criterion in accumulated physical length.
- [x] Derive the scalar weight-rescaling coboundary formula.
- [x] Identify sublinear endpoint distortion as the tempered invariance

- [ ] Generalize the scalar coboundary calculation to state-dependent weights

- [ ] Generalize from finite positive kernels to changing Banach lattices and

- [ ] Determine minimal hypotheses under which the liminf exponent becomes a
  genuine limit via subadditive or almost-subadditive arguments.
- [ ] Derive a Duhamel formula for additive defects and specify a sharp
  summability condition preserving the target exponent.
- [ ] Implement all Phase 1 extensions with hostile unit tests.
